messages:
maria: Quick changelog sweep — cutoff in 30m (11:00 PT). Please keep entries short (1-2 lines), add a component tag in square brackets, and include the PR number. Use the release template: https://go/release/changelog-template. Example: ```runtime: reduce tail-latency by batching tweaks (PR #3456)```
sam: Added my entry for the batching tweak (PR #3456) and tagged [runtime]. Trimmed to one line.
chris: My model-variant PR is still in review — do I add an entry now or wait until it merges?
maria: If it won't merge before cutoff, add the entry and mark it `needs-merge` so we can clean up post-cut. Better to have it noted than miss it.
lee: Quick question on style — present or past tense?
maria: Present tense, short fragments. No full paragraphs. e.g., `embeddings: improve recall for short queries (PR #7890)`
sam: Small nit: recommend hyphen bullets (no trailing period) — our formatter lints sentences with periods.
chris: Got it. Also, version bump. I have a bump PR (#5678) but it may land after cutoff. Where does that live in the flow?
maria: Version bumps are applied during the RC merge step. If you need an early bump, ping the release-candidate channel and include justification.
release-bot: :alarm_clock: automated reminder — changelog cutoff in 15 minutes. Please finalize entries. /release-checklist
lee: Tagged my infra change as [infra] and shortened the blurb. Also please avoid merging large refactors during this window — makes notes noisy.
sam: :thumbsup: agree on avoiding big refactors now.
maria: Thanks everyone — I'll assemble and do a final polish at 11:05 PT. If you want help tightening wording, reply here with your line and I'll condense.
chris: Thanks — posting PR link here for context: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pulls/4567
maria: One more formatting reminder: include component in the start, then colon, then the short blurb, then space and `(PR #)`. That makes the release-scraper happy.
sam: copied.
lee: done.
maria: Final note for branch owners: if you expect post-cut merges that affect docs or one-liners, add a follow-up issue with `release:post-cut` label so we can track.
sam: will do.
release-bot: :white_check_mark: cutoff reached — collecting notes now (automated).
